title: Nayaki Nayyar - Transforming from SaaS to an Agentic Enterprise

segments.text: NAYAKI NAYYAR: OK.
Nayaki Nayyar.
I'm the CEO of Siteimprove.
The topic I was going to cover today in the next five minutes
is how we, as Siteimprove, who have been in the industry
for over 20-plus years, transformed from a traditional
SaaS business into what we call the agentic enterprise,
especially in the world of content intelligence.
If you take a step back and look at what's really
happening around us, we live in an AI-driven world
with infinite content.
And when I say content, you have web content, mobile content,
social content, documents, all kinds
of content that large, big, global enterprises
struggle with.
We have over 5,500 customers worldwide across Global 2000,
Fortune 500 companies, across financial institutions,
health care, public sector, all kinds of various industries.
And one of the key challenges that every customer
that we talk to has is to make sure that content is compliant.
And when we say content is compliant,
content is accessible, especially
with EAA, European Accessibility Act, in Europe.
In North America, we have what we call ADA,
American Disabilities Act-- requires every large enterprise
to make sure their content is compliant.
In addition to that compliance problem,
customers are also struggling with what
we call content visibility.
In today's day and age, where search
has evolved beyond the traditional searches
into the AI-driven searches-- raise of hands.
How many of you use all the other AI-driven searches
for finding all your content, finding all your information
you're looking for?
I'm sure, pretty much-- this is the agentic conference.
So I'm sure all of you are using AI-driven searches.
And the next problem is, in this world,
when everyone is a developer, when everyone can build content,
when everyone can design content, how do you
ensure that content is compliant and is performing?
So our response-- and I'll go through all the various agentic
use cases we built--
is to shift left, is to address this problem
at the time of creation, as developers,
as designers, as content creators are creating
the content, are building apps, are generating
more and more designs to be able to detect those issues
upfront during the creation and remediate those issues.
Which is why last year, we released
what we call our agentic content intelligence
platform across four key pillars,
across accessibility agents, to be
able to detect issues and auto-remediate
those accessibility issues at the time of creation;
conversational analytics agents, to be able to--
you can ask any question.
It will automatically generate your reports
and dashboards-- search agents, to make
sure your content can be visible in all those AI-driven searches;
and content strategy agents, for you
to make sure you can do content briefs, content
drafts, and all kinds of content descriptions there.
And we also released what we call MCP server for us
to be able to integrate agent-to-agent integration
across all these AI-driven tools,
across levels of the world, Copilots of the world,
VS Codes of the world.
And that has really transformed how we bring integrations
to the market, which used to take maybe, I would say,
weeks or months sometimes-- can now
be done in days or even minutes.
So let me do a very quick-- this is a recording of a demo
that we captured, just so that you
can see how easy it is for us to do these integrations.
This is with the Lovable app that we integrated,
just asking what agents it has access to.
And it immediately detects the various Siteimprove agents,
and Lovable agents, and also the browser agents.
And say, OK, what can you do with the Siteimprove agents?
It will highlight the various agentic capabilities.
We have our AlphaDetect agent, our AI rules agent,
our auto-remediation agents, and as I'm running this in live.
So now, let's grab the URL of this website
that you see on the right-hand side
and do a quick accessibility check.
And when I run that check, you can see,
it has highlighted approximately five issues there.
Now, let me do a quick prompt for agents
to work with each other, our Siteimprove agents
to work with Lovable agents, to be
able to quickly detect what those issues are
and auto-remediate those issues.
You can see, it's calling the agents through our MCP server
and detecting what issues it has,
and it automatically remediates those issues.
This, ladies and gentlemen, used to take us
anywhere from weeks to months to detect these issues
and auto-remediate those issues.
Now, you can see, it can pretty much be done in minutes.
That's what we mean is to help our customers,
all the content that they have, this infinite volume of content
that they have, is to keep that content
compliant and performing.
It's not an either/or solution for us.
It's an and solution.
And that's all running on one single platform.
With that, thank you all.
